name: Lustful Retribution
source:
Oceanville — a sunny coastal college town where the beach is never far, the parties never really stop, and everybody seems to know everybody. Everybody except you.

The protagonist left Oceanville when he was six years old, after his mother's heart attack turned his family's life upside down. Thirteen years later, a college acceptance letter brings him back to the hometown he barely remembers. His childhood friend Sebastian is waiting at the station — loud, overexcited, and already planning their first party — and for a little while, student life is exactly what it should be: new classmates, a welcome party, a round of spin the bottle, maybe even a first kiss.

Then reality hits. His father can no longer afford the dorm fees, and the only option left is moving in with old family friends: a wealthy couple and their two daughters — girls he apparently played with as a kid, though neither of them seems happy to share a roof with a stranger now. Winning over two hostile housemates might be harder than any exam... and a fresh start in Oceanville may not stay "fresh" for long, because the town remembers more of his past than he does.

Between lectures, house rules and awkward family dinners, a whole college life is waiting to be lived: making friends and enemies on campus, standing up to the local bully, dating the girl from the café, throwing massive house parties — and, together with his three best friends, founding FISTS, the university's very first martial arts club, with all the trouble that comes with it.

Features:

A choice-driven story where dialogue options and bigger decisions shape your relationships, unlock or lock scenes, and are remembered later — even the fights you win or lose carry forward.
Free-roam segments: explore the house at night, wander parties room by room, and decide who to talk to, who to help — and who to spy on.
A fully functional in-game smartphone: text with characters, take calls, check contact bios that grow as you get to know people, track your current objectives in the Tasks app, browse photos, change wallpapers and listen to the soundtrack.
Peacock, the in-game social network: scroll the feed, like and comment on posts, and watch the whole town react to last night's events.
A punch-by-punch fight minigame with winning and losing outcomes.
Party minigames, including a fully scripted round of spin the bottle.
A large cast of very different girls to pursue — from the shy wallflower hiding in the sauna to the two girls living right across the hall.
Unlockable scene gallery with instant replays, plus a built-in music room.
Animated scenes, a renameable protagonist, and an episodic release format.
translation:
Oceanville——一个阳光明媚的沿海大学城，海滩永远不远，聚会永远不会真正停止，每个人似乎都认识每个人。除了你之外的所有人。

主角在六岁时离开了海洋维尔，因为他母亲的心脏病使他的家庭生活发生了翻天覆地的变化。十三年后，一封大学录取通知书让他回到了他几乎不记得的家乡。他儿时的朋友塞巴斯蒂安正在车站等着——大声、兴奋，已经在计划他们的第一次聚会——有一段时间，学生生活正是应有的样子：新同学、欢迎派对、旋转瓶子，甚至可能是初吻。

然后现实就来了。他的父亲再也负担不起宿舍费，唯一的选择就是搬去和老朋友住在一起：一对富有的夫妇和他们的两个女儿——显然是他小时候玩过的女孩，尽管他们现在似乎都不乐意与陌生人同住一个屋檐下。赢得两个敌对的室友可能比任何考试都更难……而在海洋维尔的新开始可能不会保持“新鲜”太久，因为这个小镇比他记得更多的过去。

在讲座、家庭规则和尴尬的家庭晚餐之间，整个大学生活正在等待着度过：在校园里结交朋友和敌人，勇敢地面对当地的恶霸，与咖啡馆里的女孩约会，举办大型家庭聚会——并与他的三个最好的朋友一起创立了学校第一个武术俱乐部FISTS，并克服了随之而来的所有麻烦。

特点：

这是一个由选择驱动的故事，对话选项和更大的决定会塑造你的人际关系，解锁或锁定场景，并在以后被记住——甚至你赢或输的战斗也会继续下去。
自由漫游部分：晚上探索房子，在一个房间一个房间里徘徊，并决定与谁交谈、帮助谁以及监视谁。
一款功能齐全的游戏智能手机：与角色发短信、接听电话、检查联系人简介（随着你认识他人而不断成长）、在“任务”应用程序中跟踪你当前的目标、浏览照片、更改壁纸以及聆听配乐。
Peacock，游戏内的社交网络：滚动信息源，对帖子进行点赞和评论，并观看整个城镇对昨晚事件的反应。
一场拳打脚踢的战斗小游戏，有输赢结果。
派对迷你游戏，包括一轮完全脚本化的旋转瓶子。
一大群截然不同的女孩可供追求——从躲在桑拿房里害羞的壁花到住在大厅对面的两个女孩。
可解锁的场景画廊，可即时重播，还有内置音乐室。
动画场景、可重命名的主角和剧集发布格式。
